This MIT-licensed fixture is a source snapshot of the `AquariusLang_MarbleRun_3D` repository taken on 2026-10-08. The Aquarius files are unchanged copies. It lets CI build the marble website and run its eleven-stage integration script without requiring the separate local project. To test the live project, pass `-MarbleSource ..\AquariusLang_MarbleRun_3D` (a sibling checkout) to `scripts/build-web.ps1`.
